Generate Kelly decision tree mermaid flowchart

Source: R/diagrams.R
generate_kelly_decision_mermaid.Rd

Creates a mermaid flowchart showing the Kelly staking decision tree. Threshold values are extracted from kelly.R defaults.

Usage

generate_kelly_decision_mermaid(pkg_path = ".")

Arguments

pkg_path

Character. Path to package root.

Value

Character. Mermaid flowchart code.

See also

Other diagrams: generate_cv_walkforward_mermaid(), generate_data_pipeline_mermaid(), wrap_mermaid_fenced(), wrap_mermaid_html()
